mentions.name: Eidetica
mentions.description: A decentralized database built on top of syncing CRDTs, currently in a proof-of-concept stage with known security holes. Features are still being built out and kept unstable rather than finalized. Accompanied by the write-up 'Using CRDTs + Sync as a Database'.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://eidetica.dev

I've been building a Decentralized Database built on top of syncing CRDTs, and recently got it to a point I can demo. It's definitely in a "proof-of-concept" stage though, known security holes and all.
